title: Why do traffic lights have three colours?
examples: Why do we have to stop at the red light?
What does the yellow light mean for cars?
Can we go through the lights if they are flashing?

explain.say: Red means stop. Cars must wait at a red light.

draw.text: Why do traffic lights have three colours?

explain.say: Amber means the light is changing. Drivers get ready to stop.
Green means drivers can go, if the road is clear.
Red means stop. Green means go. Amber is a warning in between.
When you cross with a grown-up, wait for the green person. Then look both ways and walk across.
If the green person is flashing, wait for the next green.

items: Wait for a clear green person

faq.q: Why does the light change colours?
faq.a: The light changes colours to tell everyone what to do. It keeps traffic moving safely for all people.
asks: What is the purpose of the colours?

faq.q: What should I do if the light is flashing red?
faq.a: Flashing red lights mean stop and wait.
asks: What does a flashing red light mean?

faq.q: Does amber mean I can go a little bit?
faq.a: No, amber means you should prepare to stop. You should slow down and get ready to stop your vehicle.
asks: Is amber a warning to go?
What is the rule for amber light?

faq.q: Can I cross when the light for cars is amber?
faq.a: No. Wait for the green person. Then look both ways and cross with a grown-up.
asks: Is yellow light okay for crossing?
When is it safe to cross the road?

faq.q: Do the lights work the same in all countries?
faq.a: Most places use red for stop and green for go. However, some places might use different colours for signals.
asks: Are traffic lights the same everywhere?
Do all countries use these three colours?

facts: Red light always means stop for vehicles.
Green light means drivers may go if the road is clear.
Amber light warns that the light is about to change.
Traffic lights help keep roads safe for everyone.

quiz.say: The traffic light turns red. What must drivers do?

wrong.1: Speeding up at a red light is dangerous.
wrong.2: Every car must stop at red, even if it wants to turn.

quiz.say: The light turns amber. What should drivers do?
quiz.why: Amber comes before red. Drivers slow down and get ready to stop.

wrong.0: Amber warns that red is coming, so slow down.
wrong.2: The horn is for warnings, and amber means get ready to stop.

quiz.say: The green person lights up. What can you do?
quiz.why: Green means you can cross. Look both ways first, then walk across.

wrong.0: Always look first, in case a car is late to stop.
wrong.1: The red person means wait, and the green person means you can go.
